title: A Novel Embedded Feature Selection and Dimensionality Reduction Method for an SVM Type Classifier to Predict Periventricular Leukomalacia (PVL) in Neonates
summary: The source reports unseen-test-set prediction accuracy for the clinical retrospective task. The result is limited to the study cohort and test split; external validation and clinical benefit are not established.
ai_technology: A support-vector-machine type classifier uses embedded feature selection and dimensionality reduction to predict neonatal periventricular leukomalacia.
